title: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
lede: Everful, which sources products from Chinese factories for smaller retailers and handles the process through delivery, raised a $48.5 million Series A led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India and January Capital.

points: Former Alibaba executive Sisi Song and Kevin Han founded it in 2024 as a jewelry wholesaler before it went multi-category.
Song says it is on track for $100 million in annualized revenue by year end, shipping over 5 million items a month to more than 60 countries.
Unlike marketplaces, it takes on sourcing, order consolidation, quality control and logistics, and verifies its 30,000-plus factory partners.
AI agents automate trend tracking, supplier search, cross-factory order coordination and logistics.
The money goes to US and European expansion, AI for product customization, and more e-commerce integrations beyond Shopify.

sections.text: Everful applies agents to a whole operations chain rather than a chat feature: the product is the sourcing work itself, automated from trend spotting to delivery.
